reviews.title: Pairing
reviews.text: Pairing is a game of luck it seems, I have a 2026 R125 and MyRide doesn’t pair with Bluetooth properly at all. As soon as I leave the bike reconnecting means I have to delete the entry, create an entire new one, pair it from there and hope that it does and even then that’s 15 minutes of my time wasted already… very disappointing.

reviews.title: Just doesn’t work
reviews.text:
Super disappointed, brand new bike turn the bike on and the app icon comes on screen then just vanishes. Open the app and it shows disconnected, press connect and it just spins and fails to connect. 
Whole system seems needlessly over complicated and worse for it. Tried every form of resetting and unpairing/pairing best you get is a single session which quickly breaks then never connects again.

Meanwhile my KTM I just go into bike setting and open for pairing, find it in Bluetooth on phone and hit pair. Then worked seamlessly for years straight, second I turn on bike my phone wakes up and notifies me of my expected route time and any music playing on phone or incoming calls can be controlled from the bike. Yamaha developers have clearly never heard of KISS.

reviews.title: iOS Connection Issues
reviews.text: When are you going to fix the IOS 26< connection issues. Comments on all Tenere forums re connects first time when pairing, then doesn’t reconnect after bike restart. Forums say Android ok. Come on fix IOS please.

reviews.title: Generally ok. Save/store poor

If this part of the app is not sorted then it will be deleted for something more reliable.

reviews.title: No connection
reviews.text: I tried everything to get the bike to connect to app. I started with making sure there was a solid connection, then tried “ forgetting” the Bluetooth and re adding. Second I re downloaded the app and then started the app first then turned the bike to on but not running the engine. Third I disconnected the battery for about 15 mins and tried both re downloading the app and re adding the Bluetooth as well as making sure the sequence was app running then moto to on. I checked my phone settings to “ app always running and tried multiple settings g changing in Google Maps including disabling google assist. I searched online and tried everything I could for an at home reset. I updated to iOS 26.4 which I read is a big issue. It was connecting prior to the update with minimal issue. After trying all the above it would connect but immediately drop. So that’s resetting the moto via the battery, resetting the app including manually adding VIN and QR scan on CCU.

reviews.title: Navigation stopped working
reviews.text:
Everything was fine with the app until a recent iOS update (26.3.1). Now when you search for a destination there is no synchronisation with google maps… so you can’t set a destination making the Turn by Turn navigation on the bike redundant.
I have deleted and reinstalled the app to no avail and checked all the permissions etc.
Phone calls and notifications still seem to work as does the weather so there is a connection… just not maps. 
Very frustrating
